title: edithea guerrerensis
intro: Edithea guerrerensis, commonly known as the "Mexican Tea Tree," is a plant species native to Mexico and Central America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety and stress due to its adaptogenic and anxiolytic effects. The health benefits of Edithea guerrerensis include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Edithea guerrerensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
